in_arabic.name: Ruhee
in_arabic.long_meaning: Ruhee هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. A name derived from the Arabic word 'Rah' meaning contentment, satisfaction, and ease. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the name Ruhee bestows a sense of calmness and serenity upon the bearer.
